comparison.objective: Seat a cocked tri-clamp on two ferrules and tighten its wing nut; candidate fractures and recovers four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require alignment and force regulation, but tri-clamp seating/drawing-up tests joint registration and tightening, not stabilized mandrel hammering or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Clamp squarely seated and tightened versus four notch fractures, four contained tangs, retained inserts, and no damage. Record has no specs or numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: The central tested outcomes—closing a sanitary joint versus impact-fracturing and recovering internal tangs—are meaningfully different.
